audit_scope.mode: read-only saved reports, manifests, code, and saved outcomes

decision_basis: The registered later-period strict net R>10 goal failed: 210 -> 152 (-58). Full-period strict net R>10 also fell 367 -> 259 (-108). Later total net R improved by 170.559207R, but the saved month-block test is p=0.29724 and later mean net return remains negative.

baseline_reconciliation.result: The V9 long source and generated baseline have the same 41,814 event keys; all checked economic, time, identity, censoring, and exit fields match exactly within the stated floating-point bound.

aggregate_recalculation.result: Independent full/earlier/later/crossing counts, strict net-R tails, total net R, and mean net bp reproduce the saved summary.

economic_identity.reference: config.json round_trip_cost=0.002 and saved closed outcomes
economic_identity.result: For both arms, net_return=gross_return-0.002 and net_r=net_return/initial_risk_frac; all closed rows are finite and all censored rows have nonfinite economic outcomes.

tail_classification.result: Recomputed strict >10 statuses exactly: retained 194, lost 173, gained 65, neither 41,430. No censored row contributes to either arm's strict >10 count.

time_split.result: Earlier contains only entry<split and exit<split. Crossing rows are explicit (326 baseline, 259 new) and have zero overlap with earlier; no entry or exit timestamps are missing.

saved_completion_aggregate.result: Summed per-stream baseline/new long events, closed rows, total net R, and strict >10 counts reproduce long_trades.csv.gz; net-R sum difference is 2.274e-13.

matched_control_saved_target_mapping.result: The 41,814 source V9 long control rows and generated baseline control rows match field-for-field. All 83,676 generated control rows map one-to-one to target outcomes; target outcome/censor values and matched flags are exact. For all 41,814 common baseline/new targets, stream, side, month, target vol_bin, and selected control timestamp match (NaT treated as equal).

matched_control_denominators.result: Full/earlier/later matched-pair and unmatched denominators, paired excess R, and saved random p values reproduce; full matched pairs are 41,644/41,719 and later matched pairs are 25,513/25,568.

control_evidence_limit.claim: Every random control candidate is in the same contemporaneous ATR/close volatility bucket.
control_evidence_limit.reason: The saved controls contain the target vol_bin but do not contain the selected control candidate's ATR/close or control-side vol_bin. Proving this would require reopening raw price/cache evidence, which is outside this audit scope. The common-target selection identity and saved source-baseline parity are checked, but this bucket-membership claim is not marked passed.

findings: The primary later-period high-R count gate fails by 58 trades; the full-period count also falls by 108.
The later total net-R improvement is not a demonstrated success: saved delta is +170.559207R, month-block p=0.29724, and mean net bp remains -43.354518 -> -42.635343.
The earlier period loses 42 strict >10 trades and 456.555380R; full-period total net R falls 613.193505R and mean net bp changes from +2.821062 to -4.965523.

The arithmetic, baseline parity, strict-tail classification, fixed-cost identity, and explicit crossing exclusion are internally consistent. This supports the negative rejection conclusion but does not prove execution quality or alpha.
No conclusion about real execution, current market behavior, funding, slippage, liquidation, or causal alpha is supported by these saved outcomes.
unverifiable: Control-side volatility-bucket membership, as described above.
The validation.json claim that raw source caches were unchanged before/after was treated as reported evidence only; raw caches were not opened or rehashed in this bounded audit.
The validation.json report of 108 related checks was not treated as an independently rerun result here.
